evaluated_controls.mechanism: Extracts JWT -> looks up user -> validates active membership in header X-Tenant-ID -> constructs immutable TenantContext
evaluated_controls.bypass_resistance: Header tampering without valid membership immediately returns 403 Forbidden; path/header mismatch returns 403 Forbidden.

evaluated_controls.mechanism: Every query explicitly enforces WHERE tenant_id = :active_tenant_id and composite primary/foreign keys
evaluated_controls.bypass_resistance: Cross-tenant resource lookups yield 404 Not Found, preventing tenant enumeration.

evaluated_controls.mechanism: Sanitizes delimiter tags (<KNOWLEDGE_BASE_CONTEXT>), rewrites instruction headers ([UNTRUSTED_HEADER]), strips Unicode zero-width characters
evaluated_controls.bypass_resistance: Retrieved documents and user inputs are strictly framed as passive data beneath immutable developer security instructions.

evaluated_controls.mechanism: Fernet symmetric authenticated encryption with MultiFernet rotation and automatic secret masking (***1234)
evaluated_controls.bypass_resistance: Tampered ciphertext triggers safe DecryptionError; plaintext keys are never logged or stored.

evaluated_controls.mechanism: validate_provider_endpoint blocks cloud metadata (169.254.169.254), link-local IP ranges, and non-HTTP schemes
evaluated_controls.bypass_resistance: Attempts to point BYOK providers at AWS/GCP/Azure internal metadata or local services (file://) are rejected at configuration time.
